image_description: A baby wearing a light blue long-sleeved onesie and striped socks is lying on its back on a folded blue and yellow mat placed on a stone bench in an outdoor park setting. To the left are a sippy cup and a plastic bottle; to the right is a black bag. The background features trees, bushes, rocks, and a building with a red roof.

The labels on the bottle and cup show slight warping and inconsistency with the cylindrical geometry, typical of AI text/object rendering issues.
